tools.name: describe_schema
tools.description: Provides details about the database schema, including table names, column names, their data types, and brief descriptions. Use this to understand the available data before formulating queries or KPI requests.

tools.name: run_safe_query
tools.description: Executes a read-only SQL query against the database. This tool is suitable for retrieving specific data, filtering records, or performing custom aggregations not covered by predefined KPIs. Ensure the query is valid SQL and adheres to safety constraints.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: The SQL query string to execute. Must be a SELECT statement.

tools.name: get_kpi
tools.description: Retrieves pre-defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to diagnostic lab bookings. Use this tool to quickly get insights on common business metrics without writing custom SQL.

parameters.name: kpi_name
parameters.description: The name of the KPI to retrieve.

kpis.name: monthly_revenue_trend
kpis.label: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpis.formula: sum(amount_inr) grouped by month(booking_date) where status = 'Completed'

kpis.name: bookings_by_city
kpis.label: Bookings by City
kpis.formula: count(booking_id) and sum(amount_inr) grouped by city

kpis.name: revenue_by_lab_partner_and_package
kpis.label: Revenue by Lab Partner and Package
kpis.formula: sum(amount_inr) grouped by lab_partner and package_name where status = 'Completed'
